subject: Fit assessment playbook & timeline — kickoff & milestones
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@lumensys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fit assessment playbook & timeline — kickoff & milestones

Alex — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Below is a concise recap and a proposed lightweight "fit assessment" we recommend to validate Redwood for the three prioritized use-cases you described (customer support triage, internal knowledge search, and billing note generation). Please review and confirm owners/timing so we can lock the kickoff.

1) Primary success criteria (what Lumensys will evaluate)
- Accuracy: Top-3 generated answers match documented KB answers for 75% of sampled queries.
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for single-turn queries under test load.
- Cost posture: projected per-100k request cost within 18% of your current baseline.
- Integration: ability to pull recent KB updates via S3 sync and produce up-to-date answers.

2) Proposed 4-week plan (compressed, low-risk):
- Week 0 (kickoff): access provisioning, test dataset snapshot, and alignment on success criteria + gating rubric.
- Week 1: baseline runs + configuration (model variant, quantization profile, caching policy).
- Week 2: focused tuning and run weekly benchmarks; iterate on prompt/template.
- Week 3: final validation, load spike test, and readout with decision recommendation.

3) Owners / roles
- From Redwood: Marissa Cole (technical lead — integration + benchmarks), Ben Carter (SRE/infra contact), Irene Choi (program owner / commercial).
- From Lumensys: Alex Dunn (product owner), Priya Sharma (SRE/credentials & data).

4) Immediate asks (by EOD Wed):
- Lumensys: provide a 2-week snapshot of KB files + sample query set (min 200 queries). See checklist attached.
- Redwood: share fit-playbook and SOW draft attached; Marissa will schedule the kickoff calendar invite once access is confirmed.

Attachments: [Attachment: fit-playbook-irlv1.pdf] [Attachment: lumensys-data-access-checklist.xlsx] [Attachment: sow-draft-20270412.docx]

Next steps: if that timeline works, we'll confirm a kickoff for the week of Apr 19 and lock a 30–45 minute technical sync followed by weekly 30-minute check-ins.

Thanks — Irene

Irene Choi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@lumensys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@lumensys.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fit assessment playbook & timeline — kickoff & milestones

Irene — thanks for the clear recap and the materials. Quick responses from our side:

- The success criteria look reasonable; the 75% top-3 is a good starting point. We will also add a qualitative CSAT check from our support SMEs at the readout.
- Timeline: compressed schedule is preferable. One ask — we have an internal release the week of Apr 26, so final readout the week of May 10 would be ideal. Can we shift the compressed 4-week plan by one week (kickoff Apr 26)?
- Data access: Priya will need the checklist filled and a short S3 role with least-privilege read access. We're OK sharing a 2-week snapshot but cannot include PII fields; we'll redact before sharing.

Other notes: we need to confirm whether Redwood's hosted API will be used for baseline runs or whether you expect us to run against a dedicated private deployment. For procurement reasons, we'd prefer hosted API for the fit assessment unless we see a clear blocker.

I'll loop in Priya for the data object and tentative kickoff availability.

— Alex

Alex Dunn
Senior Product Manager — Lumensys
alex.dunn@lumensys.com | +1 (212) 555-0148
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@lumensys.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@lumensys.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fit assessment playbook & timeline — kickoff & milestones

Alex/Priya — thanks for the notes. A few clarifications and small changes on our side so expectations are clear:

1) Shifted timeline: confirming we can slide the kickoff to Apr 26 and target final readout week of May 10; we will run the 4-week compressed plan starting Apr 26 (so baseline runs will occur May 3–9).

2) Hosted vs private: for the fit assessment we recommend Redwood's hosted environment (faster to provision and cheaper for short trials). We will document any variance in latency/cost that would change under Dedicated. If we find architectural blockers, we'll flag them as early blockers in week 1.

3) Data & redaction: understood on PII. Priya — when you share the S3 snapshot, please include a column mapping file that lists fields removed/redacted so our evaluation can account for that in the readout.

4) Attachments & kickoff agenda: attaching a 1-page kickoff agenda and a minimal SOW stub. I'll propose two kickoff slots on Apr 26 (10:00–10:45 PT or 14:00–14:45 PT). If neither works, we'll find an alternate.

Attachments: [Attachment: kickoff-agenda-20270413.pdf] [Attachment: sow-draft-20270412.docx]

I'll schedule the kickoff tentatively for Apr 26 10:00–10:45 PT and will send calendar invites once we get confirmation on data access.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0122
From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@lumensys.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fit assessment playbook & timeline — kickoff & milestones

Marissa/Irene — confirmed. We will:
- Share a redacted 2-week KB snapshot and the sample query set by Fri Apr 16 EOD (Priya will send the S3 role details today).
- Kickoff: Apr 26 10:00–10:45 PT works for our team. Please send the invite.
- Agreement: we accept the hosted API baseline for the fit assessment. If we need dedicated capacity later, we'll revisit procurement.

One small add: for the readout, can Redwood include a delta report that shows where answers changed after tuning vs baseline (so our SMEs can quickly see regressions/improvements)? That would help our internal sign-off.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Alex
